subject: Elected Officials Terms and Limits
overview: The committee deliberated on proposed charter revisions concerning City Council confirmation powers and terms of office for elected officials. It voted against City Council confirmation of department heads and against council term limits, voted to maintain two-year council terms, and voted to set the mayoral term at four years with a four-consecutive-term limit.

items.title: Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the January meeting.

items.title: Department Head Confirmation Power
items.summary: Rejected a proposal to grant the City Council power to confirm or deny mayoral appointments of department heads.

items.title: City Council Term Lengths
items.summary: Approved keeping two-year terms for all 11 City Council seats.

items.title: City Council Term Limits
items.summary: Voted to not impose term limits on City Council members.

items.title: Mayoral Term Length
items.summary: Approved extending the mayor's term of office from two years to four years.

items.title: Mayoral Term Limits
items.summary: Approved limiting the mayor to four consecutive terms or 16 consecutive years, whichever is greater.

items.title: Listening Sessions and Survey Updates
items.summary: Received a summary of 15 recent community listening sessions reaching approximately 90 residents, as well as an update on approximately 650 responses received in the charter survey.
